cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a floating sky garden of hanging vines and flowering terraces above the clouds — lying on her front; a hangar maintenance bay — standing; a small late-night neighbourhood cinema foyer beside a softly glowing abstract film poster — waiting through the end credits outside the auditorium; a lit dance stage or milonga floor — checks the photo on the back screen of a camera at chest height; the riverside park at the Red Cliffs on the Yangtze — standing; a rooftop infinity pool with the city skyline behind it — holds her keepsake up beside her face; a sheltered tidal lagoon with a wooden bathing ladder and floating amber lamps at dusk — sitting at the dry ladder landing after a dip; a starship data archive — sitting on the ground; the Zhuge Liang shrine on the Wuzhang Plains plateau — holds a bound bundle of bamboo slips against her chest; a castle courtyard rose garden around a stone fountain — standing; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — lying on her left side; a small rural station with a wooden bench and a single platform — carries a camera by its grip at her side; a riverside seating area waiting for festival fireworks — lifts a folding fan open to just below her eyes
